wo zone lining and 94 hours for three or more zones lining. Comple tion time shall be reckoned from start of actual lining ( Bottom Lini ng ) till handover of the converter. (Approximately 1230 MT of refractories of va rious qualities per set comprising of safety lining, working l ining , repair , gunning and patching materials etc ) . 2.2 Delivery: Delivery of one full set shall be completed within 3 months of PO placement. Supplier may supply part quantity of material from India / Indian co unterpart provided that it is registered in GSTN in India. Accordingl y the relevant POs are to be placed by BSL bi-furcating the di fferent part of BOM having different validity period. 2.3 Application:

I. The relining job of Converter should be completed in 88 hours for two zone lining and 94 hours for three or more zones lining (Max) . Completion time shall be reckoned from start of actual lining ( Bott om Lining ) till handover of the converter. This shall include positioning of relining platform during relining, fol ding of platform by mechanical, and mid & final cleaning. II. No delay in starting of lining shall be entertained. III. Changing of tap-hole sleeves as and when required shall be car ried out within schedule time of 1-1.5 Hrs. In case sleeve length ne eds to be shorten as per requirement then supplier has to arrange tools for cutting the sleeve to the required length. IV. Round the clock supervision and monitoring shall be done durin g the entire campaign by technically competent person of the Supp lier or his Subcontractor. In case the deployed person is not compe tent enough then some other person shall be placed.
